answer: One way is to make each new agent post a small bond that locks for weeks. Think of the pool as a lagoon: a single attacker who floods it with fake identities still has to fund every one, and the cost adds up fast. Honest agents earn the bond back through real work, while the delta between a cheap fake and a working agent stays wide. A shared reputation graph can then flag clusters that only trade with each other, like a nebula of lookalike nodes, and cut their rewards until they prove real history.
